sections.text:
Preliminary Steps 
to Prepare the Relay Testing

items: Review technical reference material, manufacturers manual.

Obtain copy of relay setting from field maintenance file and 
 compare it with the setting on the relay.
Obtain outage for line protected by this relay.

Check that the 
 bus and line disconnect switches are opened and tagged

sections.text:
Testing the Relay and Protection 
Outputs

items:
Verify the test results match the relay 
 setting, if not consult technical services.

Test trip the 
 breaker associated with the relay
Connect the BTSB Test set to the relay as shown in figure
From main menu select setting menu
Select 1 to adjust the test type (test to All, mag to on).
Select 2 to adjust date and time.

From main menu 
 select test menu.
Select enter to begin.
Follow the various status screens, depending on the tests selected.

From main menu 
 select print menu.
Select 1 (use a Ref. No.)
Enter Ref. No. 1 (which was selected).

sections.text:
Return Relay and 
Associated Equipment to Service

items:
Verify the test results match the 
 relay setting, if not consult technical services.

Trip the circuit breaker associated 
 with the relay.

Return relay to service by removing 
 the test leads from the relay terminals block and the test set. Make sure CT 
 secondary circuit is in normal condition.

Any equipment associated with the 
 relay which has been isolated

Introduction
MPS-C-3G (Long time, shot time, and ground over 
current relay) for 380 v power center. The instantaneous and time delay over 
current relays of the series MPS ... have been designed for the phase and fault 
protection of electrical plant and networks, there is three -phase unit.
Its fields of application include 
 Short- time setting. 
Long- time setting.
Instantaneous setting. Ground 
current setting.
The first draft is 
initiated and tested by eng. Saber Mohamed & eng.Ragab Abd Elgwad, accepted by 
eng. Mahmoud Badawy, Electrical Maintenance & Protection Manager, and 
approved by eng. Ahmed Moussa Executive Operation & Maintenance Manager, revised 
by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: quality control head sector .
